title: Invertibility and naturality of the fixed global pullback-counit map
statement: Let $g:T\to S$ be a morphism of schemes [def-pc-scheme], with unbounded derived categories $D(S),D(T)$ [def-pc-derived-category], derived pullback $F=Lg^*$ [def-pc-derived-pullback], and direct image $R=Rg_*$ [def-pc-derived-direct-image]. Write $H_X(P,Q)=R\operatorname{Hom}_X(P,Q)$ [def-pc-global-derived-rhom] and $r_g$ for exact scalar restriction along $\Gamma(S,\mathcal O_S)\to\Gamma(T,\mathcal O_T)$. Fix the adjunction $a_g$ and Leray comparison used in [lem-pc-global-hom-adjunction]. Let $p_g(P,Q):H_S(P,Q)\to r_g H_T(FP,FQ)$ be the pinned pullback comparison [def-pc-global-hom-pullback-comparison], and define $c_g(M,E)=p_g(M,RE);r_g H_T(1,\varepsilon_E)$, with $\varepsilon$ the counit of $a_g$. Then each $c_g(M,E):H_S(M,RE)\to r_g H_T(FM,E)$ is invertible. For every arrow $f:P\to Q$ in $D(S)^{op}\times D(T)$, the functors $A(M,E)=H_S(M,RE)$ and $B(M,E)=r_gH_T(FM,E)$ satisfy $A(f);c_g(Q)=c_g(P);B(f)$.

proof.text: Fix the canonical adjunction a, tensor comparison t, tensor-Hom bijections and Leray comparison used by the pullback map. For arbitrary A,M on S and E on T, tensor-Hom, a and t identify Hom(A,RHom(M,Rg_*E)) with Hom(Lg*A tensor Lg*M,E), and tensor-Hom and a identify the latter with Hom(A,Rg_*RHom(Lg*M,E)). Expand evaluation and the mate; the triangle identities identify postcomposition by the internal counit composite with these bijections. Yoneda proves that composite invertible.

Apply RΓ(S,-) to the internal isomorphism. Compose with the pinned Leray isomorphism of lem-pc-global-hom-adjunction. Its naturality moves the internal-Hom counit factor to the other side of Leray. Unfold the canonical global pullback comparison to obtain precisely c(M,E). Functors preserve isomorphisms. Naturality of evaluation, tensor comparison, both adjunctions and Leray proves the square for any arrow in D(S)^op × D(T).
